results.notes: Scanned/image-based PDF from UT Austin course materials. AITP Code of Ethics with obligations to management, fellow members, and society, plus Standards of Conduct.
Official IFLA long version from ifla.org. Ethical propositions for librarians and information workers.
17-page digital code of conduct from Ethics & Compliance International (ecintl.com), the consulting arm of ECI.
Council on Foundations statement adopted June 1980. Hosted at The Philanthropist journal.
Section-by-section summary (July 2021, v2.0) from NDWA official site. Covers wages, hours, safety, written agreements, standards board.

NLC does not publish a standalone code of ethics. Downloaded Michigan Municipal League Ethics Handbook as best proxy -- covers model ethics ordinances, standards of conduct, conflict of interest, and enforcement for city officials.

results.recovery_error: NASWA (National Association of State Workforce Agencies) does not publish a standalone code of ethics or professional standards document. Their about page, bylaws, and resources contain no ethics code. Organization focuses on workforce policy advocacy and program administration.

results.notes: IPMA Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct (March 2015). Seven sections covering professional ethics, stakeholder commitments, workplace standards, sustainability, and societal responsibility. Note: this is IPMA (International Project Management Association) which is the parent org; IPMA-HR (now PSHRA) sells their ethics guide through a bookstore.
Official IEMA Code of Practice PDF from iema.net. Framework of seven behaviours for environment and sustainability professionals. IEMA now rebranded as ISEP.
10 core principles covering ethical excellence, integrity, conflict of interest, harassment-free environment, resource stewardship, and violation reporting. Adopted Sept 28, 2025.

results.recovery_error: AACE (American Association of Code Enforcement) website is Cloudflare-protected. No standalone code of ethics found in public searches. Organization emphasizes professionalism and public safety but does not appear to publish a formal ethics code document publicly. ICC partnership page also lacks ethics code reference.

results.notes: 2014 CMI Code of Conduct and Practice leaflet. Hosted at University of Huddersfield. Covers honesty, integrity, competence, respect, and reputation of profession.
Official NALS PDF from ymaws.com CDN. Contains mission statement and Code of Ethics with 10 canons covering competency, confidentiality, conflict of interest, and ABA compliance.
File already existed in DOCUMENTS directory.

results.recovery_error: IFPO (International Foundation for Protection Officers) does not publish a standalone ethics standards document. Ethics is embedded in their CPO certification curriculum and The Professional Protection Officer textbook. Website is 403-blocked. Multiple search strategies (direct site, academic, filetype:pdf) all failed to locate a standalone ethics document.

results.notes: USBG policies page including Member Code of Conduct, harassment policy, whistleblower policy, and social media policy. Covers honesty, integrity, respect, diversity, conflict of interest, substance abuse awareness.
National Auction Association (formerly National Auctioneers Association) Code of Ethics. 8 principles: integrity, respect, fiduciary duty, compliance, confidentiality, loyalty, duty, professionalism.
Official PayrollOrg (formerly APA) Code of Ethics PDF. 8-point code covering compliance, accuracy, confidentiality, continuing education, and peer support. Established early 1980s.

UBC in Alberta Code of Conduct (addendum to Trade Rules). 12 responsibility areas including professionalism, fitness for duty, zero-tolerance substance abuse, workplace respect, anti-discrimination, and organizing. Enforcement via UBC Constitution Sections 51-52.
NSPE summary of AAES member society codes of ethics, which documents TMS endorsement of the NSPE Code of Ethics. TMS formally adopted NSPE code as its ethical standard.
RETA Section 1800 Membership document containing the Code of Conduct. Covers professional integrity, health/safety, certification standards, and violation reporting.
Version 1.0 from FAA Safety website. Seven sections: general responsibilities, third-party safety, training, security, environmental issues, technology use, advancement. Released July 2009.
Joint code by Nautilus International, RMT, and UK Chamber of Shipping. Approved by Maritime & Coastguard Agency. Covers shipboard discipline, duties, conduct standards. Hosted at alphamarine.ie.
